blocks.text: Computing ka sab se bara musbat asar yeh hai ke maloomat tak rasai (accessibility) barh gayi hai. Internet ki wajah se log taqreeban har mauzoo par bohat si maloomat tak pohanch sakte hain, aur taleem aur ilm ki rukawatein toot gayi hain.
Misal: Coursera aur edX jaise online educational platforms door daraz ilaqon ke students ko duniya bhar ki mashhoor (prestigious) universities ke courses karne ka mauqa dete hain.

Is ke ilawa computing ne communication (baat cheet aur rabta) ko behtar banaya hai: ab log duniya bhar mein aasani aur tezi se jur sakte hain. Facebook aur X (Twitter) jaise social media platforms ne na sirf zaati rishte aasan kiye balke samaji tehreekon (social movements), jaise #MeToo movement, ko duniya bhar mein maqbooliyat (global traction) dilayi. Pakistan mein 2014 ke Peshawar school attack ke bare mein aagahi phailane, madad jama karne aur yakjehti (solidarity) dikhane mein social media ne bara kirdar ada kiya.

Computing ne naye industries aur naukriyon ke mauqe paida kar ke economic growth (maeeshat ki taraqqi) bhi barhai hai. Daraz jaise e-commerce (online karobar) platforms ne purane karobari tareeqe badal diye hain, aur Pakistan ke chhote karobar ab poore mulk balke doosre mulkon ke customers tak bhi pohanch sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: MCQ 8: Muashre par computing systems ka musbat asar kaunsa hai? Computing ne muashre mein communication ko kaise mutasir kiya? (Short question 6)
blocks.explanation: MCQ 8: (b) Maloomat tak behtar rasai. Communication: ab log duniya bhar mein aasani aur tezi se jur sakte hain. Facebook aur X (Twitter) jaise social media ne zaati rishte aasan kiye aur #MeToo jaisi tehreekon ko duniya bhar mein phailaya; Pakistan mein 2014 ke Peshawar school attack ke baad social media ne aagahi, madad aur yakjehti mein bara kirdar ada kiya. Saath hi (7.5.2) social media ghalat maloomat bhi tezi se phailata hai.

items: Musbat asar: maloomat tak rasai (Coursera, edX), behtar communication (Facebook, X, #MeToo, Peshawar school attack 2014), maeeshat ki taraqqi (Daraz).
